ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a white-to-black pixel ratio of approximately 4:1, with high-intensity pixels dominating the medial surface and low-intensity pixels defining the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation mapping to the trailing edge and lateral tips. A vertical black band at the central notch. Large-scale yellowish-tan pixel fields (diatom coverage) concentrated in the mid-lobe regions, surrounded by high-intensity white margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated 45-degree angle at the vertex and significant inward penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases toward the distal tips, creating a jagged, uneven boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a broad concave curve from the central notch to the tips, while the leading edge (bottom) shows a distinct convex sweep toward the lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete, circular white pixel clusters (approx. 3-8 pixels in diameter) scattered across the medial left lobe and upper medial right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally on the lower left medial lobe, breaking the high-intensity background pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark circular lesion or mark is visible within the central black pigment band near the notch vertex. The far right distal tip exhibits irregular tissue loss with visible dark/reddish-brown edge pixels.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown biological staining (biofilm) covering approximately 65% of the visible ventral surface area, most intense in the center of each lobe.
